item.title: Two-Year Yields Jump as Warsh Vows to Pull Down Inflation
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: “Call it what you want, but this is the exact forward guidance the market was looking for at the July FOMC meeting,” said George Catrambone, head of fixed income at DWS Americas. “He’s going far beyond what was expected, dismissing wage inflation and claiming policy isn’t really restrictive. It’s a pretty big 180 degree turnaround.”
